name: Primo's Dungeon
detailed_description:
You are Primo, a humble farmer living peacefully on your farm. Your quiet life of fishing and gardening is shattered when monsters emerge from a nearby dungeon, attacking your home. With no other choice, you must take up arms and descend into the dungeon to defeat the threat.

Features

+ Procedural Dungeon Exploration

  • Procedurally generated levels ensuring no two playthroughs are identical

  • Navigate through 25 challenging floors with increasing difficulty

  • Challenge the final boss to defeat the threat once and for all.

+ Combat & Progression

  • Real-time grid-based movement and combat system

  • Discover and equip weapons and armor found throughout your journey  

  • Gain experience and level up to increase your combat effectiveness

  • Collect consumable potions to boost health, speed, and attack power

+ The Farm

  • Explore your farm and the surrounding area between dungeon runs

  • Interact with NPCs who provide guidance and story context

  • Save your progress and return to continue your quest

short_description: Primo's Dungeon is a 2D adventure dungeon crawler that combines classic roguelike elements with real-time combat. When monsters attack your farm, you must venture into an ever-changing dungeon to defeat them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.4 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c compatible graphics card with 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
